prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what you want (spray/airbrush vs. UV beds), your neighborhood, budget and how much you value cleanliness/experience. A quick answer I can give now:

1) Quick question: do you want a spray (sunless) tan or a UV/tanning bed? And what part of Charlotte or ZIP code are you in?

2) How to pick the best salon (use these checklist items when comparing places)
- Type of service: spray/airbrush (safer) vs. laydown/stand-up UV beds. Make sure the salon offers what you want.
- Reviews and photos: check Google Maps, Yelp and Facebook for recent reviews and before/after photos.
- Technician skill and certifications: for spray tans, ask whether techs are certified and which solution/brand they use (Norvell, VersaSpa, Mystic, etc.).
- Equipment & maintenance: for UV tanning, ask bed age, bulb replacement schedule and whether they clean booths/liners after each use.
- Cleanliness and hygiene: in-person impression matters—clean waiting area, fresh towels, sanitized equipment.
- Customization and consultation: the best salons do a brief consultation (skin type, desired shade, previous tans, allergies) and tailor the solution or exposure time.
- Pricing & packages: compare single sessions vs. membership packages and check cancellation/no-show policies.
- Safety: if you use UV beds, follow exposure limits. Dermatologists recommend sunless spray tans over UV tanning because of skin cancer risk.

3) If you want, I can look up the current top-rated salons in Charlotte for you right now (tell me your neighborhood or ZIP). I’ll return a short list of 3–5 salons with ratings, distance, what they specialize in, and anything reviewers mention consistently.
